entry: V2 H1_SD absorption_early unchanged; all entry thresholds, original SL, initial risk distance unchanged
risk: UnitR per initial risk; no risk/leverage increase or compounding; no account return claim
new_dates_reason: First weekday-of-month samples with public trade tape; exclude June/Sep/Dec firstdays that fall on weekend; convenience sample, not continuous or random
new_dates_status: Locked before downloading/replaying new outcomes; not globally untouched historical certification
structural_rule: Nearest opposing H1 boundary already known at touch, if forward of actual entry; target=min(2R,roomR), else fallback2R. No future target movement. Record fallback count.
execution: V2 quote model1s; BUYask/SELLbid; delay1s; quote-triggered exits at executable sampled quote; no full parity
be_rule: Move stop to entry price only after1R observed, effective next quote; not cost-neutral
trail_rule: After1R, stop=max(prior stop, prior executable peak minus0.75R); update only after current quote exit checks, effective next quote
partial_rule: Close half at first observed1R executable quote and half at2R/stop/timeout. Charge proportional exit fees and financing per closed fraction; charge entry once.
time_protect_rule: At30min, if observed MFE<0.5R close; otherwise original120min cap. Stop and TP checked first.
selection: Use only Feb/Mar TRAIN one-position results: require n>=5, positive meanR and PF>1 under1x and1.5x; rank by meanR per common opportunity under1.5x, tie max cumulativeR DD then id. If none qualify, select least-bad train diagnostic by same ranking and mark failed training; never relabel as qualified.
paired_comparison: All variants same entry events, plus identical-common-complete event pairs vsBASE. One-position schedule independent by variant; report skipped overlaps and censoring.
